description: The console's case workspace over the live source mirror. operating.ingestion first fills a fresh state directory with the Portal relations of the assembly-order and purchase-order chains (GET only, paged, non-atomic); then, offline over those captures (no Workbench API client exists in the workspace), the six Quality AO packets and the newest purchase order with a received line (picked at run time: pick=PurchaseOrder+ReceiptLine) are opened through the generic tools (plx.find for the root, plx.object of the root and its same-record twins, plx.investigate for every question family of the root's type, each cited value, conflict and gap recorded on the case), the AO packets' originals attached through the GET-only Graph reader, and each case's workspace (timeline, originals, gaps, conflicts, actions) is built for the investigator and for two narrower readers. Records structural counts per reader, with the projection's ontology links around each case counted per link type as that reader's tools show them (relationship_nodes, relationship_edges, relationship_truncated), and asserts that no reader sees a row of a relation its audience withholds and that the printed summary holds no row data. While the Portal reporting API fails, the ingestion's Portal units report source_error and the run reports blocked_upstream: requests whose root is not held are blocked (blocked_upstream:portal), never failed and never absent, and the check is blocked, never a pass. Live-unverified until the live check runs it.
notes: Live-unverified until the live check runs it; module tests are injected-transport (operating/tests/test_case_workspace_live.py: the ingestion runner over the in-process FakeWorkbench, originals over the in-process Graph FakeSender; the spec's own command and expectations are run there over the fixture, and a Portal that answers HTTP 500 at ingestion is run there too and meets expect_blocked). Readers: the investigator (operations + quality + purchasing, confidential), operations only and operations + quality. Each case's audience is narrowed at open to the investigator principals the mirror audience grants on the relations the case's own words (question, roots: the requested identifier or the picked root's display value) came from: an AO case names its AO code (public.assembly_order / app_manufacturing_order, operations), so it stays readable to both narrower readers (silver rows and, for operations only, the packet withheld: withheld markers expected); the picked purchase order names its PO number (purchasing relations only), so both narrower readers get status not_readable for it. row_leaks counts a withheld row's value (a digit and 4+ characters, or any 8+ characters; not also in a row or original the reader may read) found as a whole token anywhere in that reader's workspace, the case's own question, roots and uncited items included (case_text_leaks is that part); values_skipped_short counts what is too short to check. Expected honest failures, named in cases[*].missing: an AO the mirror does not hold (missing_data:not_found:*), an identifier two unrelated records carry (ambiguous_identifier), or no purchase order with a readable received line in the capture (the pick's typed cause: pick_linked_absent, pick_linked_unjoined, pick_source_not_captured:<source> or pick_not_reached). Timing risk (unmeasured): 16 relations at up to 100,000 rows each (page size 5000, up to about 320 GETs), one offline projection, six SharePoint downloads and the renders share one 1800 s timeout; seconds.ingest/open/render and ingestion.units[*].counts are recorded so the first run measures it. A relation over the mirror's row bound reports cap reasons in ingestion.units[*].reasons. The JSON of every workspace stays in {tmp} (no --output-dir). Replaces the retired case-script checks case.ao_case_script and case.ao_packets, whose measurements continue in eval.dev_baseline (F1 chain, F3 quantities); case.unfamiliar_order and case.packaging_oracle (formerly case.packaging_case_script) remain their own checks on the general path. Live live-2026-10-20T22:59:46Z (checked 2026-10-20T22:43:45Z, results/latest.json): exit 0 in 376 s, 7 of 7 cases opened, 0 failed, and the result is blocked with cause relation_unavailable (part ingestion:portal_relation, source portal-workbench-api, error_code mirror.relation_unavailable): a Portal relation the key cannot read, an upstream source gap whose grant is owner work. The check reaches a typed verdict, not a hang; nothing is loosened.
